derived_from: shared-v2 (worker, relay, tasks, timeouts, RSS sampling, checker gate, per-run home cleanup unchanged except as listed in README)
task_order: t01,t02,t03,t04 repeated 8, same original toolbox prompts/checkers as shared-v1/v2

claude.model_id_status: UNVERIFIED: claude-sonnet-5-5 is the first-party ID; the gateway may use another spelling (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5). probe-claude.sh settles it; if it differs, edit only this field (and nothing else) before gate-v3.sh.

effort_mapping.label: medium
effort_mapping.budget_tokens: not used: rejected with HTTP 400 on Claude Sonnet 5.5
effort_mapping.reason: Sonnet 5.5 supports adaptive thinking only; the depth control is output_config.effort (low|medium|high|xhigh|max, default high). 'medium' is the same label as the GPT cohorts and the level Anthropic recommends as the starting point for agentic coding on Sonnet 5.5. Thinking can not be disabled (disabled returns 400), so every harness runs thinking-on.
effort_mapping.enforcement: the relay overwrites thinking and output_config.effort on every request, whatever the harness sent, and records both the requested and the forced values per request
effort_mapping.sampling: temperature, top_p and top_k are removed by the relay (non-default values return 400 on Sonnet 5.5); removals are audited
effort_mapping.thinking_display: default (omitted); display does not change thinking or billing

claude.relay_anthropic_headers: anthropic-version defaults to 2023-06-01 when the client omits it; anthropic-beta is forwarded as sent and recorded per request; x-api-key and authorization are never forwarded

codex.billing: ChatGPT subscription via the managed model gateway

effort_mapping.label: medium
effort_mapping.enforcement: relay forces reasoning.effort and max_output_tokens (as shared-v2)

codex.model_id_note: Same ids as shared-v2 (proven through the integration for Ante/Pi/Hermes). Codex sends the -m value verbatim; if Codex rejects the slash form at gate time, change here only.

cell_order: for repeat 1..3, for model, for level (1, 8), for harness in an order rotated by repeat

ante.note: same binary as shared-v2 (campaign-20261030), referenced read-only

pi.note: same install as shared-v2, referenced read-only

hermes.note: same install as shared-v2, referenced read-only

codex.note: newest release at least 3 days old on 2026-10-30 (npm min-release-age=3); 0.166.0 existed but was newer

claude-code.note: newest release at least 3 days old on 2026-10-30; 2.1.314 to 2.1.316 existed but were newer

telemetry: off for every harness (ANTE_TELEMETRY=off; Claude Code DISABLE_TELEMETRY and nonessential traffic off; Codex analytics and update checks off)
raw_homes: deleted after each run once receipts/meta/samples are durable; homes-manifest.json retained; workspaces kept
measurement: 3 repeats per cell; provider routing/model backend snapshot and upstream caching uncontrolled; Claude (gateway credits) and GPT (ChatGPT subscription) use different provider routes; the GPT cohorts are not comparable with Claude timings on infrastructure grounds
